source.title: DENR CALABARZON to Assess Mangrove Area in Noveleta, Cavite for Establishment as Science-based Conservation and Management Site
source.access: Indexed official page reviewed; direct page fetch returned HTTP 403. No local copy retained.
source.reuse: Citation and minimal factual crosswalk only. No license or permission to republish text, images, lists, or geometry was established.

findings.sourceNames: A mangrove assessment site in Barangay San Rafael IV, Noveleta, Cavite, in a partnership to establish a science-based mangrove conservation and management site.

reportedAreaStatements.description: The article's introductory description of saline swamp and mudflats.
Mangrove forest within the planned project site.
Adjoining area described for future rehabilitation and management, not mangrove-forest area.

findings.biodiversityContext: The page reports mangrove-plant names and bird sightings. It does not provide a fish list, waterbody extent, coordinates, or a mapped boundary.
findings.featureIdentity: The barangay and municipality match the existing Noveleta mangrove research lead. The project's management footprint and the underlying connected waterbody remain unresolved.

scopeDecision.action: Retain Noveleta Mangrove Area as a wetland research lead; add this DENR source; remove the unrelated Caliraya/Lumot copepod occurrence source from this lead.
scopeDecision.removedSourceReason: The GBIF Caliraya/Lumot record review is limited to reservoir copepod occurrences and does not support a Noveleta mangrove locality or fish-status claim.

nextResearch: Identify source-backed connected-water and wetland extent for the Noveleta site without using project management footprints as water boundaries.
Find item-level fish evidence tied specifically to the Noveleta site or an explicitly bounded adjacent waterbody; keep municipal fishing-ground lists separate from site-level presence.
Review source-specific reuse terms before copying any species table, map, or image.
